row:
I’m Jackie, and I’m unapologetically crazy about dogs :)

So much so that I've decided to revolve my life around them! I was a professional dog walker for 6 years, and am now carving out my dream of starting a dog rescue. This channel offers guidance, tips, encouragement, and a sense of community to dog owners and pet professionals with weekly videos all about dogs!

My goal is to help put a smile on every dog’s face by building a community of unapologetically dog-crazy people who want to give dogs the same love and respect that they show us every single day. 

Connect With Me:
Email - inruffcompany@gmail.com
Instagram - http://www.instagram.com/jackietodd_
Facebook - http://www.facebook.com/inruffcompany
